hebrewText: וְ/נָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּ/חֹ֧שֶׁן הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל לִבּ֖/וֹ בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְ/זִכָּרֹ֥ן לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative

tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest

properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style

tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
